name: Murmur: Rhythm
additional_info: Pings the location of all nearby Monsters, NPC's, and Players, even through walls, with a colored circle. Also gray-scales your screen while active. The color indicates the health range of the target: Red = ≤33%, Yellow = 34% to 66%, Grey = ≥67%. The color display is disabled on players with Not a Scratch, always displaying grey regardless of their health amount. Rhythm will end early if you stand up (without Soulbreaker's Heart Reverb Talent) or take damage.
desc: An application of your Soul Murmur that enables the user to perceive the subtle murmur emanating from all things. Press G while crouched.
